variants.label: 青白剑罡
variants.desc: Jade-white sword wind. A clean crescent of pale jade and ivory energy sweeps from behind the shoulder around the moving blade toward the front at frames 4-5, with 2 thin secondary curved speed trails hugging the waist and blade. Bright white core, muted teal edges, a few silver pixel shards. Elegant, sharp, airy, confident wuxia swordsmanship. Peak crescent diameter about one character height. No gold flame, no lightning, no huge magic circle.
variants.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a redesigned basic sword attack animation sprite sheet for the SAME existing wuxia hero in the reference image. Reference image is the existing 8-frame ordinary attack strip: lock the black high ponytail with gold tie, youthful male face, navy-black short robe with gold edging, white inner lapels and sleeves, small red waist sash, dark trousers, armored boots, slim straight silver Chinese jian sword. Preserve the existing compact roughly 3-head-tall pixel character, NOT a newly designed hero. Crisp intentionally drawn pixel clusters, dark precise outlines, HD-2D pixel RPG asset, no photorealism, no smooth vector or airbrushed artwork.
Output ONE horizontal strip of EXACTLY EIGHT equally spaced square animation cells in a SINGLE ROW, ideally 2048x256, each cell 256x256. Genuine transparent background, not a checkerboard drawing. No labels, text, grid lines, borders, scenery, ground shadows or UI. Eight complete character poses, same size and same facing RIGHT in every cell, full weapon/effects contained in each cell with safe padding, never cross a cell border. Fixed camera, stable foot anchor at local (128,224), standing character height about 135 pixels. Stage the character around the center with sufficient room for the rightward sword effect. Each frame contains the hero AND its locally attached special effect baked into the same sprite. Effects should follow the sword and body rather than float independently. Keep the face and torso readable. Powerful beautiful arc silhouette at the attack peak, restrained outer particles.
Action is ONE fast ordinary sword slash, NOT an ultimate, no enemy, no aerial jump, no persistent aura, no detached projectile. Eight chronological beats: 1 ready stance sword lowered with no effect, 2 short compressed windup with first tiny energy streak, 3 shoulder/hip rotation accelerating sword, 4 energetic slash sweep with ribbon following actual blade path, 5 full extension strongest arc, 6 follow-through and sharp dissipating fragments, 7 settle with tiny fading fragments, 8 return to same ready stance as frame 1 with no effect. Draw distinct consecutive poses, not eight repeated impact illustrations.
Variant direction: Jade-white sword wind. A clean crescent of pale jade and ivory energy sweeps from behind the shoulder around the moving blade toward the front at frames 4-5, with 2 thin secondary curved speed trails hugging the waist and blade. Bright white core, muted teal edges, a few silver pixel shards. Elegant, sharp, airy, confident wuxia swordsmanship. Peak crescent diameter about one character height. No gold flame, no lightning, no huge magic circle.

variants.label: 赤金烈斩
variants.desc: Vermilion-gold force slash. Same hero and basic attack, with a slightly lower grounded stance and forceful rising diagonal blade cut. Blade-attached angular ivory-gold cutting ribbon with amber inner edge and small vermilion trailing sparks, warm short power streak tightly follows the forearm and waist. Peak at frames 4-5 resembles a broad carved golden wedge, then fragments into a small spray of glowing pixel embers in frame 6. Heavy and punchy but fast and repeatable. No burning costume, no permanent fire aura, no floor explosion or beam.

variants.label: 墨影残像
variants.desc: Ink-shadow speed slash. Same hero and basic attack, with a compact stepping lunge and sharp horizontal blade path. At frames 3-5, ONE faint partial smoky charcoal-blue afterimage of the previous shoulder/ponytail/arm silhouette trails behind the body, visually subordinate and attached to the motion, never a second full character. Two thin ivory-silver blade trails edged muted indigo, plus tapered ink-brush-like pixel wisps sweeping behind the hip. Frame 5 strongest clean silver slash with small ink flecks, frames 6-7 dissolve promptly. Crisp ghostly quickness, elegant original wuxia ink-and-silver aesthetic. No purple neon, no magic circle, no duplicated full bodies.
